Three elements (base salary $440k +3.5%, bonus 55%/$242k +13.9%, RSU grant $2.2M +10%) fall within CPO authority under CAP §4.1. However, four deviations exceed any single CPO approval: guaranteed bonus floor (75% of target for 2 yrs, $363k) is a categorical structural prohibition requiring Committee override; CIC severance multiplier 2.0× (+100%), CIC double-trigger equity acceleration to 100% (+$825k), and non-CIC severance 12 months (+38%) each exceed the 25% CPO threshold under CAP §4.3. GC co-approval is implicated for 409A/280G/securities risk but is supplemental. Where multiple tiers are triggered, the highest governing authority prevails: the Board Compensation Committee must authorize this arrangement.
